title: Apache North Sea workers stage third strike round, Unite says production halted
summary: Investing.com -- Offshore workers at Apache’s North Sea platforms staged a third round of rolling strikes over the weekend, halting production at all seven of the U.S. company’s UK assets, the Unite union said, as it vowed to continue the action until the company improves its pay offer.
